bounds-swapped.undoes: ISSUES measures width against width and height against height

template-height-preset.undoes: a template is laid out for the poster's own height

autoarrange-height-preset.undoes: Auto-Arrange fits the poster's own height

zoom-fit-from-preset.undoes: zoom-to-fit uses the poster's own size

zoom-args-swapped.undoes: zoom-to-fit divides width by width and height by height

zoom-deps-dropped.undoes: zoom refits when the size changes

preview-sheet-preset.undoes: the preview draws the poster's own sheet

grid-preset.undoes: the grid covers the poster's own sheet

frame-preset.undoes: the frame around the sheet is the poster's size

guide-centre-preset.undoes: the drag guides' centre is the poster's centre

area-comment-preset.undoes: an area comment is measured on the poster's own sheet

figure-overlay-preset.undoes: the Figure tab's check rectangle is clamped to the poster's own sheet

overflow-preset.undoes: the frame grows by the overflow past the poster's own height

menu-never-custom.undoes: the size menu and preview name a custom size as custom

preview-label-preset.undoes: the preview labels a custom size with its own inches

naming-half-inch.undoes: a size is named as a preset only when it is that preset

drawn-as-stored.undoes: an unusable stored size is not drawn (review of cause A: NaN sheet, Auto-Arrange deleted blocks)

no-upper-bound.undoes: an absurdly large stored size is treated as unusable

no-string-coercion.undoes: a size stored as numeric strings is read as numbers

no-load-repair.undoes: opening a poster repairs an unusable saved size before an empty poster is laid out from it

guide-middle-preset.undoes: the drag guides' vertical middle is the poster's own middle

floor-one-inch.undoes: a sheet narrower than 3 in is unusable (re-check of cause A: 1-inch margins leave no column)

floor-exclusive.undoes: the smallest usable sheet (3 in) is itself usable

ceiling-exclusive.undoes: the largest usable sheet (1000 in) is itself usable

naming-width-only.undoes: a preset is named only when BOTH sides match it

store-no-repair.undoes: every document entering the store (open, share, import, version restore) gets a usable size (re-check of cause A, RA1)

load-ignores-row.undoes: opening a poster whose data lost its size falls back to the row's own usable size before the default
edits: return withUsableSheetSize(doc, { widthIn: row.width_in, heightIn: row.height_in });

editor-reads-raw-size.undoes: EQUIVALENT by design: the editor draws a usable size even if a document reached the store without one. setPoster repairs every document on entry, so no user path reaches this second guard
edits: const { widthIn: pw, heightIn: ph } = usableSheetSize(doc.widthIn, doc.heightIn);
const { widthIn: pw, heightIn: ph } = { widthIn: doc.widthIn, heightIn: doc.heightIn };

label-reads-raw-size.undoes: EQUIVALENT by design: the preview label reads a usable size even from an unrepaired document. setPoster repairs every document on entry, so no user path reaches this second guard
edits:
const size = usableSheetSize(widthIn, heightIn);
  const key = presetKeyFor

const size = { widthIn: widthIn as number, heightIn: heightIn as number };
  const key = presetKeyFor

naming-tolerance-wide.undoes: preset naming tolerance is 0.05 in, not 0.2 (re-check of cause A, RT6)

naming-tolerance-tight.undoes: a preset stored to two decimals (33.11 × 46.81) is still named as that preset (re-check of cause A, RT6)

drawn-rounded.undoes: the sheet is drawn at its exact size, not rounded to whole inches (re-check of cause A, RT6)
edits: const { widthIn: pw, heightIn: ph } = usableSheetSize(doc.widthIn, doc.heightIn);
const { widthIn: pw, heightIn: ph } = usableSheetSize(Math.round(doc.widthIn), Math.round(doc.heightIn));

store-ignores-fallback.undoes: RF-4 — setPoster uses the given size fallback (the share page's row, the poster's current size on restore) before the default

share-no-row-fallback.undoes: RF-4 — the share page falls back to the row's own size, as the editor does

restore-no-current-fallback.undoes: RF-4 — a restored version with no usable size takes the poster's current size

restore-fallback-width-only.undoes: F4 (last round) — the restore fallback gives the poster's current height too
